**Applied Molding Engineer –**

**Applied Technology Lab**


**LG Electronics**


**\[LG Soft India Private Limited]**


**\[Noida, India]**

  


**About LG Electronics**


Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier, better life for all.


With a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence of more than 100 subsidiaries, we operate on a truly global scale. Since our establishment in 1958, our dedication to enhancing lives worldwide through innovative products has remained unwavering. Our business domains include Home Appliance \& Air Solution, Home Entertainment, Vehicle Components Solutions, and Business Solutions.


Our management philosophy, "Jeong\-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer\-Value Creation' and 'People\-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom, fostering a collaborative work environment.


Join us and become a part of a company that is not just about creating solutions for a better life, because at LG, Life's Good.


**About the Job**


The HS Applied Technology Lab is LG Electronics' core R\&D organization within the Home Appliance Solution Company (HS), where cutting\-edge materials and manufacturing technologies are translated into commercially viable solutions for refrigerators, washing machines, dryers, ovens, microwave ovens, and air conditioners.


The **Metal/Plastic Forming \& Processing Technology Project Team** is responsible for innovating and optimizing the core manufacturing processes that give shape to LG's appliance components — from sheet metal stamping and forming to plastic injection molding and secondary processing. We bridge the gap between advanced material discovery, component design, and mass production.


The ideal candidate will join us as a Process Engineer to drive the next generation of forming and processing technologies that deliver lighter, stronger, more cost\-effective, and sustainable components.

  

  

**Responsibilities**


**Metal Forming Process Development**


* Process Optimization: Design and optimize sheet metal stamping, bending, drawing, piercing, and assembly processes for appliance chassis, drums, baskets, and structural parts.
* Tooling \& Die Development: Collaborate with internal tooling partners and die makers to develop new tooling strategies, including progressive dies, transfer presses, and fine\-blanking tooling.
* Material Utilization: Evaluate and reduce material waste through nesting optimization, scrap minimization, and lightweight gauge optimization while maintaining structural integrity.
* Formability Analysis: Perform limitation diagram analysis (LDI / FEM simulation) to predict cracking, wrinkling, and earing in sheet metal processes; validate through physical testing.

**Plastic Processing Process Development**


* Injection Molding Optimization: Develop process windows for gate design, runner layout, cooling channel configuration, and mold flow analysis to achieve balanced fill, minimal warpage, and zero shorts.
* Intelligent Molding Systems: Leverage LG's proprietary intelligent injection molding systems — including real\-time cavity pressure monitoring, AI\-driven process control, and adaptive feedforward/feedback loops — to improve cycle time and first\-pass yieldlgcorp.com \+1\.
* Mold Flow Simulation: Use Moldflow or equivalent software to simulate and optimize flow patterns, weld\-line location, sink marks, shrinkage, and residual stress in complex molded parts.
* Material Compatibility: Evaluate thermoplastics (ABS, PP, PC/ABS, PA blends), reinforced composites, and recycled\-content materials for formability, mold release, and post\-processing compatibility.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with the HS Material Application Technology Team to ensure material characteristics align with processing windows and product performance targets.
* Support DFM / DFA (Design for Manufacturing / Assembly) reviews with industrial and design engineers to reduce costs, improve manufacturability, and shorten time\-to\-market.
* Partner with Quality Engineering to define process capability studies (Cp/Cpk), Root Cause Analysis (8D/FMEA), and control plans for new programs.

**Sustainability \& Cost Innovation**


* Reduce scrap rates and improve material yield (target: 21%\+ productivity gain through intelligent process integration.
* Explore lightweight die casting, hot\-stamping, and high\-strength steel applications to reduce the weight of appliance structures without compromising durability.
* Evaluate biodegradable, bio\-based, or recycled plastics for processing feasibility in injection molding, supporting LG's carbon\-neutral and ESG.

**Documentation \& Specification**


* Develop and update Process Specification Sheets, Control Plans, PFMEA, and Traveler Documents for manufacturing release.
* Maintain Material Master Data and Bill of Process documentation in PLM systems (Teamcenter)

**Technical Requirements**


* M.Tech (Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related field) ideally from reputed institutes (NITs / IITs).
* 1\+ years of relevant experience in metal forming, plastic injection molding, or advanced manufacturing process engineering.
* Proficiency in CAE/FEA tools (Moldflow, AutoForm, PAM\-STAMP, DEFORM, LS\-DYNA); hands\-on experience with process simulation and DOE (Design of Experiments) methodology; working knowledge of mold design and die construction.
* Familiarity with quality standards: IATF 16949, ISO 9001, GD\&T (ASME Y14\.5\), AIAG Core Tools (APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA).
* Fluent in Business\-level English; Korean language skills are a plus

**Core Competencies and Working Attitude**


* **Technical Depth:** Deep understanding of material behavior during deformation, flow, and phase change — metal plasticity and polymer rheology.
* **Problem Solving:** Analytical data\-driven approach to identify root causes of process variation, surface defects, dimensional instability, and scrap generation.
* **Systems Thinking**: Ability to see the forming and processing workflow holistically — from raw material receipt through in\-process quality gates to final assembly.
* **Communication:** Clear documentation and presentation of complex technical findings to cross\-functional audiences including design, quality, procurement, and manufacturing.
* **Ownership:** Self\-motivated with ability to manage multiple project streams simultaneously, driving each from concept through deployment.
* **Innovation Mindset:** Curious about emerging technologies — additive manufacturing for tooling, self\-healing materials, and cold spray metallurgy — and assessing their commercial viability.

* Implement Finance AI and automation governance aligned with UKG’s enterprise standards for AI, security, data, privacy, legal, risk, and internal controls.
* Apply clear criteria for citizen\-led, guided, and centrally built solutions. Ensure financially significant, higher\-risk, or process\-embedded use cases receive appropriate business review, technical assessment, testing, control design, documentation, approval, monitoring, and support. Help create a governance model that enables innovation without compromising control, security, auditability, or long\-term supportability.

**Drive Adoption and Business Readiness**


* Partner with Business Owners and Transformation Delivery \& Enablement to ensure AI and automation initiatives are successfully adopted and embedded into day\-to\-day Finance operations.
* Define role changes, process impacts, training requirements, communications, readiness criteria, adoption measures, and operating procedures required to sustain new capabilities. Ensure implementation success is measured not only by technical deployment, but by actual usage, process improvement, and business outcomes.

**Lead Value Realization**


* Establish clear business cases, baselines, and performance measures for AI and automation investments.
* Track outcomes such as hours saved, cycle\-time reduction, improved accuracy, lower exception volumes, control effectiveness, employee experience, adoption, scalability, and financial value. Partner with Business Owners, GPOs, and IT to evaluate solution performance and identify opportunities to improve, expand, or retire capabilities based on realized value.

**Lead and Develop the Team**


* Lead and develop a team of AI, automation, process\-design, and transformation professionals.
* Set clear priorities, coach team members, review solution designs, and foster a culture that balances innovation and experimentation with governance, accountability, customer focus, and disciplined delivery. Build team capability in Finance transformation, agentic process design, automation discovery, functional architecture, portfolio management, change leadership, and value realization.

Success will be measured by the effective execution of the Finance AI and automation strategy and the delivery of measurable outcomes across multiple Finance domains.


* Health and quality of the AI and automation portfolio.
* Number and impact of governed, process\-embedded solutions deployed.
* Adoption and sustained usage of delivered capabilities.
* Productivity, cycle\-time, quality, and control improvements.
* Value realized versus approved business cases.
* Strength of collaboration across Global Process Owners, Business Owners, and the IT AI team.

We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
  
This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
  
  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function
  
1\. Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  
2\. Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  
3\. Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  
4\. Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  
5\. Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  
6\. Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  
7\. Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  
8\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  
9\. Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  
10\. AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  
11\. Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.
  
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES
  
  

**Essential:**  

1\. NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  
2\. Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  
3\. Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
  
4\. Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  
5\. APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  
6\. Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  
7\. Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
  
8\. Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  
9\. ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.
  
  

**Desirable:**  

1\. Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
2\. Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
  
3\. Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
  
4\. Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  
5\. Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  
6\. Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.
  
  

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  

If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. GoPaisa is a profitable, founder\-led consumer technology company built over 10\+ years with a long\-term mindset. We are now building the next phase of our payments platform, with the ambition to scale toward $1B\+ in annual transaction volume across payments, rewards and financial services.

We believe in building like enduring companies such as Zerodha: capital\-efficient, customer\-focused and designed to compound over decades.

**The role**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who combines strong backend engineering depth with the ability to lead and develop a high\-quality engineering team.

This is not a management\-only role. You will remain close to architecture, code, systems design and production problem\-solving, while also owning hiring, mentoring, execution and engineering standards.

You will work directly with the founders and can grow into broader engineering leadership as the company scales.

* Build and scale backend systems for payments and transactions

* Strengthen reconciliation, settlements and exception management

* Improve analytics, reporting and data infrastructure
* Own architecture, code reviews and production reliability
* Lead, mentor and hire engineers
* Improve engineering velocity without compromising quality
* Make GoPaisa an AI\-native engineering organisation

**AI\-native engineering**

We want AI embedded across how software is built and operated. This is not an AI branding exercise. You will help define how AI materially improves engineering quality, speed and operating leverage.

* Coding and refactoring
* Automated testing
* Code review
* Documentation
* Incident investigation
* Log and anomaly analysis
* Risk and fraud intelligence
* Workflow automation
* Analytics and reporting

* 6\-10 years of software\-engineering experience

* Experience leading engineers or technical workstreams
* Current hands\-on coding and architecture involvement

* Comfort working directly with founders
